correctness.rationale: The complex is the incompatibility-graph independence complex under the cited full source theorem; fixed simplices correspond to compatible edge-orbits with chain orientation sign. Edge-axis orbit graph folds by false twins to a chain of k triangles; toggling tips leaves two alternating vertex covers, giving trace zero for even k and 2(-1)^((k-1)/2) for odd k. Existing rotation r^2=(-1)^(k-1)I then fixes all remaining dihedral traces and rational representation types. Fresh independent signed fixed-face sums from actual perfect matchings over n=4,6,8 agree, including n=6 odd-axis trace -2.
